name: Simple Raid HUD
teaser: A clean and configurable raid HUD for health, hydration, energy and magazine ammo.
description_html:
Simple Raid HUD

Simple Raid HUD adds a clean and modern interface that displays essential player information during raids.

Video Preview

Features

  • Total player health
  • Hydration
  • Energy
  • Ammunition currently loaded in the weapon’s magazine
  • Modern split layout
  • Configurable position, size and opacity
  • Optional maximum values
  • Native Tarkov status icons when available
  • Automatic fallback icons
  • F8 key to toggle the HUD

The HUD automatically hides while the pause menu, inventory or loot interface is open. It becomes visible again when returning to normal gameplay.

Configuration

The following settings can be changed through the BepInEx configuration file:

  • HUD position
  • HUD scale
  • Background opacity
  • Refresh interval
  • Labels
  • Maximum values
  • Native icon preference

With BepInEx Configuration Manager installed, the settings can be adjusted directly in game. The HUD remains visible while changing its position.

Installation

  1. Download the archive.
  2. Extract the BepInEx folder directly into your SPT installation folder.
  3. Launch SPT.
  4. Enter a raid.

The plugin will be installed to:

BepInEx/plugins/Nayco-SimpleRaidHUD/SimpleRaidHUD.dll

Uninstallation

Delete:

BepInEx/plugins/Nayco-SimpleRaidHUD

You may also delete the configuration file:

BepInEx/config/com.nayco.simpleraidhud.cfg

Compatibility

  • SPT 4.1.0
  • Client-side BepInEx plugin
  • No profile or server database modifications
  • No network connections or telemetry
